8448.content: Shulker kin who stayed in the Hive when the Queen closed her shell and the combs stopped flying.

8450.content: Bring the sealer twelve honeycombs and three honey bottles from the Green Cell.

8452.content: Defeat a Hive Warden that climbed up from the wells and bring the sealer its plate.

8454.content: Carry the sealer's oldest wax to the elder: the Mother's cocoon in the Queen Cell is to be sealed.

8456.content: Climb the Amber Tower and bring the amber worker two diamonds to cut amber with.

8458.content: Carry two pieces of hive amber from the amber worker to a vein opener of the Facetkin in the Glass Cell.

8460.content: Bring the chorus tender thirty-two blocks of end stone and sixteen pinches of bone meal for new chorus tubs.

8462.content: Live through the day the combs remember the Flight and bring the chorus tender sixteen pieces of chorus wax caught in the air.

8464.content: Look at the gap in the Comb Bridge and bring the cell builder six iron ingots and twelve pieces of flint for new chisels.

8466.content: Live through the Waking of the Hive, when the shell-cousins climb out of the combs.

8468.content: Follow a drone's dance to a sealed cell, open it, and bring the drone warden two pieces of hive amber from inside.

8470.content: Bring the drone warden sixteen lumps of coal for the smoker.

8472.content: Go down into the Wax Deeps — the old hive inside the columns — and come back up.

8474.content: Wake the Mother of the Comb at the bottom of the Wax Deeps and defeat her.

8475.content: The Ring Hums Like the Combs

8476.content: Wake the gate ring of the Hive: the door between the cells.

8478.content: Bring the chief of a comb chorus wax and hive amber to seal new cells in the comb's row of memory.

8480.content: Find a Shulker Nest in the Hive, where the cousins who chose the hard shell over the soft life still live.

8482.content: Go to the Queen's Cell and let the Elder Nurse rest — she still tends the empty cell the Mother left.

8484.content: Live through the Flight of the combs in the Hive and bring the chief chorus honey for the Flight song.

8486.content: Find the Wax Hall and bring the master of seals shulker shells, so the kin who fell there can be sealed properly.

8488.content: Find the Queen's Cell and bring the master of amber hive amber from the cocoon, where the oldest wings are caught.

8490.content: Walk the road the drones dance — find a Drone Perch and a Purpur Arch — so the head drone warden knows the dance is still true.

8492.content: Bring the swarm pilot six pieces of chorus quartz from the islands of the Interrift.

8494.content: Fly to the Vigil Eye, the station of the Lashkin by the rift of the Eye, and come back.

8496.content: Bring the swarm pilot four pieces of hive amber for the lamps of the Queen's Court.

8498.content: Bring the swarm pilot four lumps of runaway wax: runaway drones leave it when they fly off the hull of a slow ship.

8500.content: The small glass folk of the Facet, whose heads are hollow cut crystals with a light burning inside.

8501.content: Three Lights of the Rough World

8502.content: Bring the vein opener twelve pinches of glowstone dust, four glow ink sacs and eight patches of glow lichen: the light of your own world.

8504.content: Find the Prism Gate on the plain, and be in the Gem when its veins surge.

8506.content: Bring the prism cutter sixteen pieces of nether quartz: the cutting wheel eats grit.

8508.content: Watch a crystal grow out of the Gem and bring the prism cutter eight blocks of prism glass.

8509.content: Cut Glass for the Breathing Isles

8510.content: Carry a lens cut from prism glass to a glassblower in the Breath.

8512.content: Quiet three refractors: reflections that fell out of broken mirrors and drink the light.

8514.content: Find the Mirror Hall and bring the mirror keeper two refractor lenses to set into its broken mirrors.

8516.content: Show the mirror keeper two lens crystals from the Eye: tears of the world that looks.

8518.content: Live through the ringing of the Gem and bring the resonance tuner four resonant shards knocked out by the loud rings.

8519.content: An Echo from the Rough World

8520.content: Listen at the Resonance Ring and bring the resonance tuner two echo shards from the deep dark of your world.

8521.content: The Heavy One in the Yard

8522.content: Look at the Endersmith Forge and the guard in its yard, and bring the endersmith eight blocks of obsidian for the hearth.

8524.content: Carry the edge the endersmith forged from a splinter of the Dark to the elder: it will cut the first facets of the newborn.

8526.content: Go down into the Prism Deeps, the old home of the First Cut, and come back up.

8528.content: Defeat the Prism Archon in the hall of mirrors at the bottom of the sanctum.

8530.content: Wake the gate ring of the Facet: the door between the worlds on the plain.

8532.content: Bring the chief of the cluster lumen dust and polished facet crystal to make new jars for the Count of Colors.

8534.content: Find the Light Well, where the white light of the Gem still runs whole before it splits.

8536.content: Find the Glass Tomb where the First Cut lie and drive off two refractors drinking the light around it.

8538.content: Stand through a vein surge with the cluster and bring the chief of the cluster glowstone dust — light from another world for a new jar.

8540.content: Find the Crystal Grove and bring the master of facets resonant shards for a prism without a single flaw.

8542.content: Find the Dust Dunes where the cluster's prism moths flew off to and bring light moss to plant along the home veins.

8544.content: Bring the seam warden six pieces of condensed void from the islands of the Interrift.

8546.content: Fly to the Drifting Comb, the station of the Comb Keepers by the rift of the Hive, and come back.

8548.content: Raise the class of your ship at a station dock, then return to the seam warden.

8550.content: Let a flock of skein weavers lead your ship to a cache: stay slow near the skein islands of the Interrift.

8552.content: A stocky gray folk of the Ash with bone plates on their skulls and shoulders and blue fire in their eyes.

8554.content: Knock the embers out of three strays — Ash Wraiths, the hooded fires of the Ash — and bring two soul embers to the soulfire keeper.

8556.content: Carry a lantern lit from the kin fire to a caravan guide: no caravan leaves the camp without it.

8558.content: Drive four bone gnawers off the fallen Giants for good and bring the bone carver two gnawer fangs.

8560.content: Find a gnawer burrow and show the bone carver a piece of soul marrow taken back from the thieves.

8562.content: Bring the felt maker twelve blocks of white wool: your world's wool makes the felt warmer.

8564.content: Carry eight blocks of soul cinder from the felt maker of the Ash to a felt maker of the Fruiting Folk in the Mycelium.

8565.content: The Sledges That Would Not Sit

8566.content: Find the Frozen Caravan of the strangers and bring the caravan guide four soul briquettes from its stores.

8568.content: Live through the Ghost Caravan and bring the caravan guide three bones from the cache it leaves behind.

8570.content: Bring the caravan guide two pieces of sorrow quartz, tears of the Lament set into crystal, from where the glass weeps.

8571.content: What Falls Out of a Giant

8572.content: Find the Giant's Skull and bring the ash sifter sixteen blocks of soul ash from around it.

8574.content: Live through the Pale Draw and bring the ash sifter three pieces of raw wraith iron snatched before the fire takes them.

8576.content: Go down into the Giant's Ossuary under the great spine, where the old keepers lived and died, and come back up.

8578.content: Defeat the Giant's Remnant on his bier at the bottom of the Giant's Ossuary.

8580.content: Wake the ring of frames out in the ash: the gate between the worlds.

8582.content: Bring the chief of a Giantkin kin fire Giant's bone and soul embers to mend the ring of chiefs around the fire.

8584.content: Find a Soul Pyre in the Ash and sit by the blue fire that warms nobody, the way the first Giantkin did.

8586.content: Go into the Wraith Iron Cairn and lay down the Cairn Chieftain — the chief who took the kin's warmth for himself.

8588.content: Live through the soul wind in the Ash and bring the chief soul briquettes for the great laying of the kin fire.

8590.content: Find the Bone Gate and bring the master of bone bone blocks from the warm world for a new rib.

8592.content: Find the Ash Well and bring the keeper of the kin fire soul embers to replace the ones that fell into it.

8594.content: Find the Cinder Field and bring the first guide ember tufts for felt to line the sledges on the road he never came back from.

8596.content: Bring the palm keeper six pieces of ringwoodite from the rocks of the Depths.

8598.content: Fly to the Wandering Cap, the station of the Fruiting Folk by the vent of the Mycelium, and come back.

8600.content: Bring the palm keeper three pieces of soul marrow from the Ash for the Marrow Chamber.

8602.content: Squat smiths of the Forge who are cast rather than born: living gold poured into a shell of slag, with a spark breathed into the mouth.

8604.content: Bring the goldsmith ten amethyst shards: a stone for a newly cast child's first ring.

8606.content: Break six pieces of living gold from the spikes on the anvil-isles and bring them to the goldsmith for Ferra's roof.

8608.content: Put out two Gilded Knights, the Hollow ones: gold that walks with someone else's fire inside.

8610.content: Find the Giant's Anvil and bring the slag mason eight pieces of gilded slag from it.

8612.content: Stand through the Giant's Forging and bring the slag mason two pieces of raw adamant.

8614.content: Bring the slag mason four pieces of raw verdigris from the spore country under the third vent.

8616.content: Find the Pouring Bowl, where the Forge melts itself, and bring the crucible keeper a bucket of molten gold.

8618.content: Live through the Quench in the Forge and bring the crucible keeper two salamander crystals from the crust.

8620.content: Look at the broken span of the Chain Bridge and bring the chainwright twelve iron ingots for new links.

8622.content: Show the chainwright four adamant ingots: the metal that no fire bends.

8624.content: Bring the charcoal burner sixteen oak logs for the kiln.

8626.content: Carry eight pieces of charcoal from the charcoal burner to the crucible keeper, who can't leave the melt.

8628.content: Carry a salamander crystal to a soulfire keeper of the Giantkin in the Ash, where the fire is blue and gives no heat.

8630.content: Go down into the Gilded Deeps, the bell-guild's shops cut into the slag under the isle, and come back up.

8632.content: Defeat the Gilded Smith at the great forge at the bottom of the Gilded Deeps.

8634.content: Wake the ring of slag on the anvil-isle: the gate between the worlds.

8636.content: Bring the chief of a Gilded anvil gold film and living gold for new pages in the book of pours.

8638.content: Find the Ring of Embers on the isles, where the first Gilded family poured its first child.

8640.content: Go into the Salamander Den and defeat the Firegill Salamander, which ate the roof gold of whole families.

8642.content: Live through the gold tide in the Forge and bring the chief gold blocks for the common pour of the anvil.

8644.content: Find the Foundry Ruins of the bell-folk and bring the master of gold living gold from the guild's last pour.

8646.content: Find the Slag Lighthouse and bring the master of walls glowstone to light it again for whoever crosses the Spill.

8648.content: Hunt slag beetles and bring the keeper of the great crucible their shells for lids that keep the melt from skinning over.

8650.content: Bring the anvil master six pieces of ringwoodite from the rocks of the Depths.

8652.content: Fly to the Wandering Cap, the station of the Fruiting Folk by the vent of the Mycelium, and come back.

8654.content: Raise the class of your ship at a station dock, then return to the anvil master.

8658.content: Climb into the Fulgurite Spire, the tower of the deaf Ringers, and come back down to the elder.

8660.content: Defeat the Vapor Wyrm on the crown of the Fulgurite Spire.

8662.content: Wake the ring of fused frames on the Breath: the gate between the worlds.

8664.content: Live through the dragon's exhale on the Breath and bring the glassblower two bottles of dragon's breath.

8666.content: Bring the glassblower thirty-two blocks of sand: glass from sand is clear enough for toys.

8667.content: A Bell for a New Family

8668.content: Visit the Vapor Chimes and bring the bell founder sixteen blocks of fulgurite for a new family's bell.

8670.content: Carry the nameless bell from the bell founder to the elder, for the tower of last breaths.

8672.content: Live through the ball lightning on the Breath and bring the lightning catcher two pieces of charged glass.

8674.content: Find the Storm Lantern and stand a whole lightning season through under the open sky.

9198.content: Live through the great diamond hail on Uranus and show the diamond catcher three diamonds you caught.

9199.content: The Spark of the First Fire

9200.content: Find the Clathrate Fountain in the calm band and bring the clathrate opener eight methane crystals from its frozen spray.

9202.content: Carry four blocks of methane ice from the clathrate opener to the sleep keeper, for the stacks of the Long Night.

9204.content: Bring the clathrate opener sixteen lumps of coal: warmth that does not sulk, for the stacks of the wintering.

9206.content: Defeat two cryo wisps that circle the halls of the wintering at every blink.

9208.content: Sew a cyan down parka and show it to the sleep keeper.

9210.content: Find the guests' Cryo Vault and bring the ice sculptor two cryo linings from its capsules.

9212.content: Live through the methane frost on Uranus among the growing needles of ice — with a Heating Unit in your suit.

9214.content: Find the Tilted Observatory and bring the tilted astronomer two pieces of optical glass from the guests' tower.

9216.content: Live through the aurora of Uranus: stand in the pillars of light to catch the solar wind and step out before the field turns over.

9217.content: A Question for the Deep Blue Cousin

9218.content: Carry four lying stems from the tilted astronomer to a wind harpist of the Windbearers on Neptune.

9220.content: Bring the chief of a Frostwalker dome blue ice and diamond splinters to cut a new notch in the pillar of days.

9221.content: Moths in the Middle of the Night

9222.content: Find the Frozen Probe in the calm clouds — the moth that came to the Cradle during the Long Night and froze on the wing.

9224.content: Go into the Cryo Vault and put down the Thawed Specimen — the sleeper the moths laid in a box without warmth.

9226.content: Live through a methane frost on Uranus and bring the chief blocks of coal and methane ice to keep the dome's Ember alive.

9228.content: Find the Ice Bridge and bring the master of the chisel diamonds for a chisel hard enough to finish it.

9229.content: The Station That Does Not Answer

9230.content: Find the Ghost Station in the haze and bring the keeper of the tilt the moths' circuit boards from it.

9232.content: Find a Diamond Cairn and bring the head catcher puff fruit to lure the sloths that graze there to the dome.

9234.content: The Cloud Dwellers once drifted in the cool cloud deck of Venus under living bubbles, until the great storms tore them open.

9236.content: Go down into the Acid Deeps under the plains, where the grandmothers of the Cloud Dwellers pumped the sky, and come back up.

9237.content: Let the Mother Below Fall Silent

9238.content: Defeat the Acid Matriarch in the deepest tank of the Acid Deeps.

9240.content: Wake the great ring of stone on Venus: the gate between the worlds.

9242.content: Bring the condenser keeper two buckets of water from Earth.

9244.content: Find the Old Probe on the plains and bring the condenser keeper its imaging plate — the plate that remembers what it saw.

9246.content: Bring the condenser keeper two shards of superionic ice from Neptune.

9248.content: Live through the metal snowfall on Venus in a lead helm of your own and bring the frost scraper six pieces of metal frost.

9250.content: Make a bismuth halberd yourself, climb the Tessera Steps, and show the blade to the frost scraper who sent you.

9252.content: Live through an acid storm on Venus, quiet four acid toads and bring the acid brewer two of their glands.

9254.content: Find the sulfur pools on the plains and bring the acid brewer three pieces of golden sulfide from their beds.

9256.content: Quiet three acid toads that come to lick the sulfur off the piles of the walkways.

9258.content: Live through a volcanic eruption on Venus and bring the bridge builder sixteen blocks of basalt for new pile footings.

9260.content: Find the bridge over the lava, defeat two lava serpents that hunt in its bed and tell the bridge builder who built it.

9262.content: Find the Cloud Harbor in the highlands, see how the last bubble is tethered, and bring the bubble weaver four iron chains.

9264.content: Carry an air filter woven by the bubble weaver to a frost scraper, for the visor.

9265.content: A Skin for the Red Wind

9266.content: Carry three sulfur membranes from the bubble weaver to a storm warden of the Martians on Mars.

9267.content: A Heart for the Cold Grate

9268.content: Bring the condenser keeper two compressors and eight copper sheets for a condenser that makes its own cold.

9270.content: Bring the chief of the Cloud Dwellers lead and chiseled Venus rock to sheathe the first pile of the walkway.

9272.content: Find the Brimstone Spires, the needles of rock that tore the living bubbles of the Drift.

9274.content: Go to the Burst Dome, where the guests from the Dewdrop fell too, and put down the flytrap that grew in their garden.

9276.content: Stand through an acid storm on Venus under the open sky and bring the chief water for the last verse.

9278.content: Bring the keeper of water copper tubes and valves to rebuild the old condenser on the top board.

9280.content: Bring the master of bridges hull plates and iron chains for a span over the acid gully.

9282.content: Bring the master weaver sulfur membranes and string for a bubble big enough to answer a cloud whale.

9284.content: Bring the ark keeper sixteen blocks of packed ice and two buckets of water for the garden of the Ark.

9286.content: Carry two bismuth crystals from the Ark to an orbit watcher of the Stillwatch near the Moon.

9288.content: Catch up with a comet in your ship and bring the ark keeper twelve pieces of its ice for the Seed Bubble.

9290.content: A light scout from the shipyard: a titanium arrow with crescent wings, a bubble canopy and two helium engines that burn pale blue.

9292.content: A pot-bellied hauler: a wide hold striped black and yellow like a bee — the loading marks of the shipyard — a cockpit on the nose, four engi

9294.content: A long-haul explorer: narrow wings that are solar arrays from tip to tip, like the wandering albatross that crosses an ocean without a wingb

9296.content: A fighter: short and mean, with forward-swept wings, an armored slit of a cockpit and a sting at the stern.

9298.content: The Lunarians' ship: a biconvex lens of moonstone and titanium with a huge glass at its heart and a ring of small lenses round the rim, like

9300.content: The Ring Keepers' ship: a small bronze gondola inside a huge crown of ice vanes — a sail that catches the solar wind as Saturn's rings catch

9302.content: A void scout: two pairs of broad wings of purpur-colored membrane with eye-spots, a downy body, feathered antennae.

9304.content: The Comb Keepers' hauler: a cluster of hexagonal chitin cells sealed with amber wax — every cell is a hold.

9306.content: The Facetkin's explorer: a triangular prism of prism glass that splits the rifts' light into colors — a rainbow fans out behind its stern.

9308.content: A void fighter: a chorus branch whetted into a spear — dark obsidian, purple thorns in every direction and a long sting at the prow.

9310.content: The Lashkin's ship: curved like a lash above the Eye — white as sclera, with a golden iris at the cockpit and a fringe of fine ribs along it

9314.content: The Gilded hauler: heavy as a giant's anvil, with a horn at the prow and a flat face of a deck.

9316.content: The Fruiting Folk's explorer: a mushroom cap above a stalk of a hull, glowing gills under the cap and a lantern of spore gem hanging from th

9318.content: The Giantkin's warship: a hammerhead of bone and basalt on a long haft, blue soul-fire runes burning along the bone.

9320.content: The Mourners' ship: a drop of the Lament's dark glass with lilac light inside and a tail like a falling tear.
